points: \item Implemented a self-correcting RAG system using LangChain and Mistral 7B for social engineering threat detection, improving malicious content identification accuracy by ~20% and enabling AI-native defense against deepfakes and scams at scale.

\item Built a hybrid retrieval workflow combining dense embeddings (FAISS) with BM25 similarity search, enhancing detection relevance and coverage across billions of domains, social media accounts, and dark web forums for real-time threat monitoring.

\item Developed ML evaluation pipeline to assess model performance, precision-recall tradeoffs, and anomaly detection across hundreds of threat scenarios, ensuring production-ready reliability for scalable AI systems processing web-scale data.

\item Optimized batch and real-time inference pipelines through distributed data processing frameworks, reducing detection latency by ~80% and enabling faster threat neutralization across diverse data sources at massive scale.

\item Designed ML-based anomaly detection system for identifying infringing content and social engineering attacks, reducing false positives by 25% while maintaining detection coverage and improving brand protection for enterprise clients.

\item Built end-to-end ML platform with scalable infrastructure for NLP classification and embedding models, deploying production systems that monitor and detect digital threats for OpenAI, United Airlines, Coinbase, and other recognized brands.
